description.value: Hotel Zed Victoria is a retro-themed, BC-owned boutique hotel on Douglas Street, part of a small three-property chain celebrating a '70s aesthetic and inclusive, quirky hospitality. The Victoria property features a year-round waterslide (the Zedinator), pool, hot tub, and sauna, plus a lobby stocked with board games and vintage curiosities. It bills itself as the antidote to boring travel, making it a memorable and lively base for cyclists exploring Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hotel Zed Victoria's address (3110 Douglas St Victoria BC V8Z 3K4) and phone (250-388-4345) matching OSM. The Victoria-specific amenities page mentions a waterslide, pool, hot tub, sauna, and lobby activities, but contains no mention of bike storage, tools, laundry, or cyclist-specific services. The 'World's First Bike Through Lobby' feature is explicitly attributed to the Tofino location only and cannot be applied to Victoria. Wi-Fi is confirmed via OSM's internet_access=wlan tag.
concerns: Website covers all three Hotel Zed properties (Victoria, Kelowna, Tofino); some amenity mentions (e.g., bike-through lobby, outdoor surfboard showers, ROAR restaurant) are specific to Tofino and must not be attributed to Victoria. Victoria-specific amenity page did not load in full, so cyclist-relevant amenities (storage, laundry, tools) remain unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel with confirmed contact details, a live website, and multiple room types. A solid base for touring cyclists in Victoria.

wow_evidence: waterslide (the Zedinator), pool, hot tub, and sauna... BC-owned boutique hotel... small three-property chain

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: retro boutique Hotel Zed with waterslide, Douglas St Victoria; $160-220 shoulder
